test_results.name: React #418 (P0)
test_results.detail: Error still present: 'Minified React error #418; visit https://react.dev/errors/418'. body.className='consent-banner-open' at 4s post-load. integration_issues.issue: React #418 hydration error persists after CR-201 fix. The mountedRef guard in ConsentBanner.jsx prevents body class mutation during hydration but does NOT fix the actual hydration mismatch causing #418. A different component is the root cause.

action_items: P0 - T2 STILL FAILING: #418 hydration error persists in live build main.ea6df739.js. ConsentBanner CR-201 fix is correctly coded but the #418 is caused by something else. Need to: (1) identify which component causes client/server HTML mismatch by adding React 18 hydrateRoot with onRecoverableError callback to log the specific mismatch location, (2) check for any component using window/document/Date/Math.random() in render (not in useEffect). Common suspects: animated counters, date-dependent rendering, browser-only APIs used at render time.
T6 - Dead routes: Working as expected on dev static server. No code change needed. Confirm _redirects deploys correctly to Netlify/Cloudflare for production validation.
critical_code_review_comments: CR-201 fix (mountedRef) is correctly scoped to prevent body class mutation during hydration, but the #418 error likely comes from a different component. Need to audit all components for window/document/localStorage access in render (outside useEffect). React 18 strict mode double-invokes renders — any side effect at render time causes hydration mismatch.

T2_418.bug: React error #418 (hydration mismatch) persists after CR-201
T2_418.reproduction: Navigate fresh to https://frontend-as-is-run.preview.emergentagent.com/ in clean browser. Check console for 418 error.
T2_418.cr201_analysis: mountedRef in ConsentBanner.jsx prevents body.classList mutation during hydration. This is correctly implemented. BUT the #418 error fires for a different reason — some other component renders different HTML on server vs client.
T2_418.mitigation: Add React 18 hydrateRoot onRecoverableError to identify the mismatch component. Audit all components for: (1) window/document access in render, (2) localStorage reads at render, (3) Date.now() / Math.random() in render, (4) animated counters that start from 0 vs pre-rendered value.
